title: Complement transfer: the low-vertex bound on re-attachment classes gives the bound at every vertex
statement_en: Assume: for every normal-form counterexample (n >= 3, NF(d), G hypomorphic to H, G not isomorphic to H), every vertex u of degree d and any three members of C_G(u), two are equal. Then the same conclusion holds for every vertex u, without the degree condition (Zinchenko Thm 4.4 high case via the complement, Lemma 2.5: a high vertex of G is low in the complement, which is in NF(n - 2 - d) with the complementary counterexample partner, and C of the complement is the complement of C; debe_zinchenko.md B5).
statement_lean: (∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → ∀ (d : ℕ) (G H : SimpleGraph (Fin n)), (∀ x : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d ∨ (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d + 1) → (∀ x y : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = (G.neighborSet y).ncard → Nonempty (G.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)))) → Recon.Hypomorphic G H → ¬ Nonempty (G ≃g H) → ∀ u : Fin n, (G.neighborSet u).ncard = d → ∀ K₁ K₂ K₃ : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G K₁ → Recon.Hypomorphic G K₂ → Recon.Hypomorphic G K₃ → (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u → y ≠ u → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₁.Adj x y)) → (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u → y ≠ u → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₂.Adj x y)) → (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u → y ≠ u → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₃.Adj x y)) → K₁ = K₂ ∨ K₁ = K₃ ∨ K₂ = K₃) → ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → ∀ (d : ℕ) (G H : SimpleGraph (Fin n)), (∀ x : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d ∨ (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d + 1) → (∀ x y : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = (G.neighborSet y).ncard → Nonempty (G.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)))) → Recon.Hypomorphic G H → ¬ Nonempty (G ≃g H) → ∀ u : Fin n, ∀ K₁ K₂ K₃ : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G K₁ → Recon.Hypomorphic G K₂ → Recon.Hypomorphic G K₃ → (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u → y ≠ u → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₁.Adj x y)) → (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u → y ≠ u → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₂.Adj x y)) → (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u → y ≠ u → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₃.Adj x y)) → K₁ = K₂ ∨ K₁ = K₃ ∨ K₂ = K₃
